name: Exp_Bezier_ReOpen
summary: This EA trades based on Bezier curve smoothing of price data to identify trend direction, with a ReOpen feature that allows adding positions when the trend continues. It generates buy/sell signals when the smoothed Bezier curve crosses price or when its slope changes direction, and manages multiple entries along a confirmed trend.
summary_zh: 该EA基于价格数据的贝塞尔曲线平滑处理来识别趋势方向，并具有在趋势延续时加仓的ReOpen功能。当平滑的贝塞尔曲线与价格交叉或其斜率改变方向时产生买入/卖出信号，并在确认趋势中管理多个入场。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心是利用贝塞尔曲线对价格序列进行平滑处理，消除短期噪音以识别主趋势方向。入场条件为贝塞尔曲线斜率由负转正时做多，由正转负时做空；ReOpen机制允许在趋势延续且满足加仓条件时再次入场，从而实现趋势中的金字塔加仓。出场条件包括反向信号触发平仓以及止损/止盈达到预设水平。仓位管理支持固定手数和基于资金比例的动态手数计算。资金管理方面，EA提供了止损距离设定和最大持仓限制，但ReOpen加仓机制可能导致在单边趋势中累积较大仓位，增加了回撤风险。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core uses Bezier curve smoothing on price series to filter short-term noise and identify the main trend direction. Entry conditions trigger a buy when the Bezier curve slope turns from negative to positive, and a sell when it turns from positive to negative. The ReOpen mechanism allows additional entries when the trend continues and add-position conditions are met, implementing pyramiding along a confirmed trend. Exit conditions include closing positions on reverse signals and when stop-loss or take-profit levels are reached. Position sizing supports both fixed lot and equity-proportion-based dynamic lot calculation. Money management provides stop-loss distance settings and maximum position limits, though the ReOpen pyramiding mechanism can accumulate large positions during strong trends, increasing drawdown risk.

parameters.name: ReOpenEnabled
parameters.description: 是否启用趋势延续加仓功能

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Stop loss amount, 0 disables overall stop loss

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Hedge pair net profit target in points

parameters.name: MoneyManagement
parameters.description: 是否启用资金管理动态手数
parameters.description_en: Enable money management dynamic lot size

pros: 贝塞尔曲线平滑有效减少价格噪音，信号质量较高
ReOpen加仓机制能在强趋势中充分获利
支持固定手数和动态资金管理两种仓位模式
pros_en: Bezier curve smoothing effectively reduces price noise, producing higher quality signals
ReOpen pyramiding mechanism captures full profit potential during strong trends
Supports both fixed lot and dynamic money management position sizing modes
cons: ReOpen加仓在趋势反转时可能导致较大回撤
贝塞尔曲线参数敏感，不同品种需反复优化
缺乏明确的整体仓位上限和最大回撤保护机制
cons_en: ReOpen pyramiding can cause significant drawdowns on trend reversals
Bezier curve parameters are sensitive and require re-optimization for different instruments
Lacks explicit overall position cap and maximum drawdown protection mechanism
improvements: 增加整体仓位上限和最大回撤保护，防止ReOpen过度加仓
引入波动率自适应参数调整，使贝塞尔曲线平滑度随市场状态动态变化
improvements_en: Add overall position cap and maximum drawdown protection to prevent excessive ReOpen pyramiding
Introduce volatility-adaptive parameter adjustment so Bezier smoothing dynamically adjusts to market conditions

risk_points: ReOpen加仓机制在趋势反转时可能累积大量持仓造成严重亏损
缺乏整体仓位和回撤硬限制
risk_points_en: ReOpen pyramiding can accumulate large positions causing severe losses on trend reversal
Lacks hard limits on total position size and drawdown
